newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS TO LEAN ON 134.50 IF 135.60 BREAKS.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS TO LEAN ON 134.50 IF 135.60 BREAKS.

text.p: September BTP futures traded on LIFFE were likely to reconsider their position on Wednesday in reaction to the strength of the previous day's rally, technical analysts said.
Although Tuesday saw BTPs rally up to 136.38, volume was only average and momentum petered out in the second half of the session. A concerted break of 135.60 would send the market down.

"It will have a go at 135.60, yesterday's low," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "Below there it really should have a good run to support from a trendline at 134.50/60."
September BTP futures were down 0.53 at 135.67 by 0820 GMT. The contract earlier sliced through support from congestion around 136.00.
Celaya said it was crucial for the trendline, drawn from July 15 low at 135.36 and the August 6 low of 134.73, to hold steady.
"If it breaks below there, then it will have formed a top," he said.
A technical analyst at a European bank said a head and shoulders in daily charts could be giving way to a directional move up. Tuesday's break above 136.00 may lead to 137.00.
The analyst said a close below 135.00 would be an early bearish signal.
Celaya said the upside is initially barred by the previous session's high at 136.38. Next in line come the mid July highs at 137.05 and 137.10.
"A move back through there would target the contract high," said Celaya. "That was very likely until T-bonds fell out of bed, now BTPs risk topping."
At the short end, September Eurolira futures stood 0.03 down on the day at 93.19.
